_comment: Printed-arithmetic computed fields consumed by maine_forms_engine.computations. Every formula_text is the instruction printed verbatim on the blank (tests/test_computations.py re-checks this against the fetched PDF). Warnings-only: a supplied value is always written as-is.

facts.adjusted_federal_taxable_income.formula_text: Adjusted federal taxable income (line 1 minus line 2 plus line 3)

facts.total_payments_and_credits.formula_text: Total payments and credits (add lines 7a through 7e and subtract line 7f; if the result is negative, enter a minus sign to the left of the number)
